title: anonymous resolve execute works without account without wallet
body: apiRequest omits the Authorization header entirely when no api key is present (key empty string). resolve and execute proceed anonymous with optional auth. No gate refuses anonymous use. Lewis directive: hard gate login OR x402 wallet.

title: backend optional auth lets anonymous resolve execute through
body: resolve and search and skill routes use optionalAuth middleware not bearerAuth. Only /v1/account/* requires a key. Anonymous resolve execute is allowed end to end. The gate must require account api key OR x402 wallet.

title: mcp execute swallows x402 payment no payment retry
body: MCP api() dispatches in-process via fastify inject(). A backend HTTP 402 challenge returns straight to MCP as an error string; statusCode is checked for 2xx only. No x402 payment, no wallet, no payment retry on the mcp execute path. x402 payment is broken via unbrowse mcp.

title: cli path handles 402 challenge mcp path does not payment parity gap
body: The CLI HTTP path catches HTTP 402 and calls payAndRetry via lobster pay then retries the request. The mcp execute path has no equivalent. CLI x402 payment works, mcp x402 payment does not. Payment parity between cli path and mcp path is missing.

title: setup no account registration optional silent anonymous
body: Setup explicitly no longer registers an account implicitly. Registration is optional. A fresh machine finishes setup with no account, no api key, and then resolve works anonymous. Silent anonymous success instead of an account gate or wallet gate.

title: wallet escrow session key honest skip wallet optional
body: promptFundEscrow and promptRegisterSessionKey are HONEST-SKIP stubs that print next steps and return skipped. The wallet path is optional and deferred. A fresh machine setup yields no wallet and no account, so the gate is unsatisfiable yet usage still works anonymous.

title: lobster cash wallet provision only when wallet absent not skipped
body: Setup runs npx @crossmint/lobster-cli setup only if wallet not configured and UNBROWSE_SKIP_WALLET_SETUP is not 1. Lobster cash is the wallet provision path but a fresh user still needs a human at the hosted approval URL. Setup must surface the lobster cash path as the wallet onboarding next step.

title: wallet detection lobster cash address sources
body: checkWalletConfigured reads LOBSTER_WALLET_ADDRESS or AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS or ~/.lobster/agents.json. With none of these a fresh machine has no wallet so the x402 wallet path of the gate is unsatisfied and lobster cash onboarding must run.

title: x402 payment splits server side correct break is mcp only
body: computeFlexSplits sets platform 1000 bps and contributors 9000 bps weighted by delta. The split math is correct server side. The x402 payment splits failure is purely that the mcp execute path never triggers payment so splits never settle on the mcp surface.
